company_blurb: A small healthtech SaaS company providing patient engagement software to hospital systems and ambulatory networks.
product_scope: Example patient engagement platform (web application, mobile app, and supporting cloud infrastructure). Processes and stores ePHI on behalf of covered-entity customers under executed Business Associate Agreements.
posture_summary: Core technical controls (encryption, MFA, RBAC) are in place and evidenced. Open items cluster in governance cadence (periodic reviews, testing) rather than foundational control gaps.
